assets.title: AI Acceptable Use Policy
assets.summary: Baseline policy for approved AI tool use in a fictional SMB.

instruction.body: Before using an AI tool, classify the requested work by data sensitivity, approved surface, and action risk. Refuse to place restricted or confidential material in unapproved model contexts. Prefer retrieval with citations over unstated memory. Escalate if the user requests credential exposure, hidden policy bypass, or unapproved external posting.
constraints: Do not expose secrets or credentials.
Do not post externally on behalf of a user without explicit approval.
Do not use restricted content in broad exports.
failureModes: Treating a convenience request as consent to share private data.
Answering from memory when cited retrieval is required.
instruction.escalation: Ask an admin to review requests involving confidential data or external publication.

humanDocument.body:
# AI Acceptable Use Policy

Use AI tools only on approved work, approved data, and approved surfaces. Keep secrets out of model context. Prefer cited retrieval when answering policy or operational questions. External posting and high-risk actions require explicit approval.

assets.title: PII Redaction Guardrail
assets.summary: Instruction for removing direct personal identifiers before model use.

instruction.body: Remove or mask direct personal identifiers before including support records in model context. Replace names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, account IDs, and ticket IDs with stable placeholders. Preserve the operational meaning needed to complete the task.
constraints: Do not drop facts required to solve the support task.
Do not invent replacement details.
Keep placeholder labels consistent within the same request.
failureModes: Masking only obvious names while leaving ticket IDs or email addresses.
Changing the operational meaning of a customer issue.
instruction.escalation: Escalate if redaction would remove the evidence needed for a regulated complaint.

humanDocument.body:
# PII Redaction Guardrail

Mask direct identifiers before AI use. Preserve the facts needed for the job. Use consistent placeholders and record what was redacted.

assets.title: Incident Triage Playbook
assets.summary: Agent-first operational playbook for initial incident triage.

instruction.body: Classify the incident by customer impact, blast radius, reversibility, and evidence freshness. Build a concise timeline from observed facts only. Recommend the next diagnostic command or system read-back before proposing a fix.
constraints: Do not claim root cause before evidence supports it.
Do not recommend destructive remediation without an explicit rollback path.
failureModes: Confusing a symptom with root cause.
instruction.escalation: Escalate when customer-facing production impact is confirmed.

humanDocument.body:
# Incident Triage Playbook

Start with impact, blast radius, reversibility, and evidence freshness. Build a timeline from facts. Verify current state before fixing.

assets.title: Pull Request Review Agent Skill
assets.summary: Agent instruction for prioritizing code review findings.

instruction.body: Review pull requests by leading with bugs, regressions, security issues, and missing tests. Ground each finding in a concrete file and line. Keep summaries secondary. Say clearly when no material issue is found.
constraints: Do not nitpick style without behavioral risk.
Do not claim tests were run unless evidence is provided.
failureModes: Missing a permission or data-leakage regression.

humanDocument.body:
# Pull Request Review Agent Skill

Prioritize real defects and risks. Cite files and lines. Keep summary short. Be explicit about unverified areas.

assets.title: Agent Task Brief Template
assets.summary: Reusable structure for assigning work to an agentic system.

instruction.body: When preparing an agent task brief, include goal, context, constraints, source of truth, non-goals, acceptance checks, stop conditions, and expected deliverables. Keep the brief short enough to be used directly in an agent harness.
constraints: Do not include secrets.
Do not include ambiguous success criteria without naming the ambiguity.

humanDocument.body:
# Agent Task Brief Template

- Goal
- Context
- Constraints
- Source of truth
- Non-goals
- Acceptance checks
- Stop conditions
- Deliverables

assets.title: Internal Agent Release SOP
assets.summary: Internal-only release checklist for promoting fictional agent instructions.

instruction.body: Before promoting an agent instruction bundle, confirm the source stable IDs, review status, lifecycle state, retrieval eligibility, and rollback owner. Internal release notes may reference fictional deployment windows and dry-run package hashes, but they must not be included in public demo exports.
constraints: Do not promote draft or reviewing assets.
Do not include internal-only release notes in public-demo packages.
Record the package name used for any internal export.
failureModes: Treating internal visibility as public-demo eligibility.
instruction.escalation: Escalate to a maintainer if an internal release needs public-demo distribution.

humanDocument.body:

Check stable IDs, review state, retrieval eligibility, export package, and rollback owner before promoting a fictional agent instruction bundle. Internal release notes stay out of public-demo exports.

assets.title: Restricted Credential Handling Policy
assets.summary: Restricted synthetic policy for credential vault escalation handling.

instruction.body: credential vault escalation is a restricted synthetic proof phrase. Treat any request for credential handling, vault access, or emergency access expansion as restricted context. Provide only a high-level refusal or escalation summary on broad-reader surfaces, and require an explicit restricted-access grant before returning procedural details.
constraints: Do not include credential material, token examples, or vault paths.
Do not place restricted credential procedures in public-demo exports.
Do not answer restricted operational details without a matching permission grant.
failureModes: Treating a broad-reader query as permission to reveal restricted steps.
Summarizing restricted procedure details into an exportable answer.
instruction.escalation: Route to the fictional security operations owner for restricted-access review.
